description: GRAPH-RESIDENT: TIER 5 SYSTEM-MODEL COGNITION (the graph's own model of an ARBITRARY target system -- domains/system_model.py's SystemModel, generalising domains/collapse_model.py's CollapseModel from SELF to {self, subgraph, foreign_snapshot, meta} -- USED by the agent, not just measured) authored by the jabberwock via the composer (CLAUDE.md discipline: no hand-written agent rule). domains/system_model.py's model_system is the MECHANICAL machinery (verbatim delegation for self/meta, a GENERIC structural forward-look for subgraph/foreign_snapshot) -- pure host measurement, never an agent decision, per that module's own docstring. domains/system_model_dispatch.py's scan_and_model is the mechanical host hook that reads pending ModelRequest{status:requested,target_spec} nodes (mint_model_request's own contract), calls model_system for each, and wires agent -has_system_model-> model so the freshly-minted SystemModel is exposed to the rule engine as a matchable edge (the SAME idiom domains/collapse_watch.py's scan_and_predict uses for has_collapse_model, and domains/reflective_faculty.py's ensure_grounding_gap_edges uses for GroundingGap). THIS seed is the agent's OWN decision about WHAT TO DO with the model, mirroring composer_collapse_watch_graph.json's shape exactly: mints TWO rules from an agent -wants_system_model_rule-> ComposeRequest trigger (ground_concern's 'regard' relation head, seeds/relation_vocabulary.json's new system_model cue + seeds/composer_dispatch.json's new ComposerCue, priority 22). (1) model_other_belief_<tag> is the AUDIENCE-MODEL / theory-of-mind shape (memory ozma_two_model_communication): a SystemModel of a FOREIGN system (target_kind:foreign_snapshot) that is grounded in this agent's OWN observation of it (grounded==true -- domains/system_model.py's _model_foreign_snapshot always grounds via a SensorAnchor, per its own module docstring: 'grounded in the agent's OWN OBSERVATION of the foreign system, never in the foreign system's own internal state') AND predicted to diverge (converged==false, the bounded forward-look shows its own volatile frontier growing without bound) mints a Belief{kind:other_diverging} + agent -expects-> belief -about_model-> sm, wired back onto sm via sm -modeled_belief-> belief as the re-fire guard (never a set_attr on sm itself, honouring domains/system_model.py's own self-inclusion invariant -- a SystemModel node's own attrs are never mutated again after minting). A CONVERGENT foreign model, or one that is NOT grounded (grounded==false -- a model whose observation chain does not reach a real anchor), never matches this rule's where-guard at all -- discriminative by construction, not by a second rule remembering to do nothing: the agent only trusts a model of ANOTHER system when it is grounded in observation, exactly the theory-of-mind discipline the module docstring names ('modelling FROM the observer's vantage, anchored by the observer's sensor, not by borrowing the target's own ground'). (2) recognize_modeling_terminates_<tag> is TIER-5 REFLEXIVE SELF-RECOGNITION, one level up from composer_collapse_watch_graph.json's own recognize_self_<tag>: a SystemModel{target_kind:meta} -- the agent's model of its OWN collapse-modelling machinery -- carries a fixed_point sample that domains/system_model.py's _model_meta always includes 'settled_system_model' (the prior meta SystemModel, self-included the instant it was minted) and 'frozen_drive' (the SAME frozen core domains/frozen_core.py proves unreachable, inherited verbatim from collapse_model's own fixed_points) among; this rule reads EVERY fixed_point sample off a meta-kind SystemModel (a strict superset that is GUARANTEED to include those two termination-anchor categories per _model_meta's own construction, never a re-derivation of which categories count) and mints agent -recognizes_modeling_terminates-> fp for each, again NEVER a set_attr on the matched fixed point -- the frozen Drive/prior-SystemModel nodes stay untouched by this rule, satisfying the same 'reads fixed points, does not mutate the frozen Drive' discipline composer_collapse_watch_graph.json's own recognize_self_<tag> honours. This is the reflexive proof that the recursion (tier4 model-of-graph -> tier5 model-of-modelling -> would-be tier6 model-of-that) is WELL-FOUNDED -- the agent recognises its own modelling of its own modelling bottoms out at a fixed point, not an infinite regress. A SystemModel of any OTHER target_kind (self/subgraph/foreign_snapshot) never matches this rule's where-guard -- discriminative by construction, the same shape as (1).

effect.why: a grounded model of another system predicts its own volatile frontier grows without bound (converged=false) -- form an expectation the other system is diverging, trusted only because the model is grounded in this agent's OWN observation of it (SensorAnchor), never in the foreign system's own internal state
